# Shotjoy (截趣)

Shotjoy is a local-only macOS screenshot menu-bar app (SwiftPM, AppKit +
SwiftUI) inspired by WeChat's screenshot workflow. "Screenshots, with joy."

Build: `swift test && ./scripts/make-app.sh release`
Install: copy `dist/Shotjoy.app` to `/Applications` and open it.
Permission: System Settings → Privacy & Security → Screen Recording.
Shortcut: ⌃⌘A (Control-Command-A), configurable in Settings.
Key files: AGENTS.md (agent instructions), docs/ai-install.md (copy-paste
prompts), docs/reverse-engineering.md (WeChat study), README.md.
